messages:
sam_k: quick heads-up - onboarding sampleapp fails in json-mode when tool returns top-level array; js validator errors out.
maria: can you paste the raw response and schema?
sam_k: minimal repro:
```json
[ {
  "id": 42,
  "text": "ok"
} ]
```
schema is an object with id:int and text:string.
alex: parity bug: python helper auto-unpacked single-item arrays; js helper is strict. also found retry middleware that sometimes does JSON.stringify(result) on recover, so validator gets a string.
jin: proposal: 1) remove stringify from retry middleware, 2) add a small normalize helper in js sdk: parse strings, unpack single-item arrays when schema expects an object, emit telemetry when coercion happens. keep behind feature flag.
maria: agree. add unit tests in samplekit that simulate array return and stringified-array from retry.
ci-bot: created issue #3801: "devex: normalize js fncall outputs + remove stringify-in-retry" (opened by alex).
